modernization-b34-final-noe-1080.probeLimit: Bounded grid/phase observations with repeated keys collapsed; not an all-world coverage measure, reception percentage or statistical transport distribution.

method: Original Nogova R01WarCry.Noe; copied profiles, --nosound, native Windows Vulkan synchronization validation,1920x1080,triPBR auto/TAA100%,one bounce,RT sunlight/cloud shadows,AO/water/volumetrics off. PBR Off/auto-GI Off/auto-GI On at09:00/17:30; four exterior headings per model and6 detail/interior/roof views, advancing-simulation camera translation/turning and distance retreats. Developer-camera observations, not physical traversal, Steam acceptance or mission completion.
costMethod: RTX4060Ti/NVIDIA617.14. Native scene workloads; warm10, GI Off/On/On/Off, settle4/sample6, paired interval medians. No build/census/tests during sampling. Includes normal workload variation and surrounding scenery, not isolated material costs or FPS gains. Raw stages and intervals retained.
limits: Source assessment is not full-model rendering adoption. Half-resolution family counters include scenery; eligible probe identities independently demonstrate reflector hits. Near hangar LOD0/1 remain blocked by original shape land hints. Original baked shadows, cracks, dirt, paint and fastener photographs remain artwork; no recovered albedo, measured physical coefficients, separate hardware optics, new maps or masks.
finalScopedRevalidation: Only post-full-run edit removes630/631/632, three exact factory window-strip data entries. Exact header subtraction is verified. Factory exterior/detail matrices, four factory CPU controls, movement, retreat, reflector probes and factory/yard costs rerun on final binary. Three other original-model native guards and three previously missing close CPU controls/probes rerun. Unaffected station/transmitter and hangar material controls retain their separately hashed full run; no repeated unrelated asset review.
excludedFocusCapture: Pre-final accepted run stopped when Edge took foreground, before factory-support CPU capture. Those absent controls are not counted as passed. All seven required close/factory CPU controls are completed in final scoped run.

preservation.privateDLSS: clean, remote-free; SDKs and preserved snapshots present

appearance.review: Original Nogova gameplay captures, original object transforms; matched baseline/final comparisons and native Off/auto-GI Off/auto-GI On, day/dusk, bounded advancing-simulation motion. This is developer-camera testing, not physical traversal or mission completion.
appearance.factory: Final native exterior/detail matrices retain artwork and broad authored lighting; direct native facade/concrete receiver counters remain zero. Final CPU front shows coherent brightening of the entire rough lower plaster face, retains dirt/cracks and the existing horizontal wall boundary, and has 56215 facade receiver samples versus baseline zero. No isolated inter-window bright patches remain after withdrawing630/631/632. The right door/rail brightens as a whole coated region. Final native eligible probes identify624/625/626/633/640 separately from reception. Roof/interior/support CPU facade/concrete reception remains zero; no new whole floor/roof GI claim.
appearance.station: Rough plaster treatment is modest in native daylight/dusk controls. Native front facade reception is7650 in the full accepted run and7661 in the final guard, versus baseline zero. Full-run CPU front is7671 versus baseline zero. Final close CPU front-of-hut control has zero facade reception; those shutter/door faces are not the lower-half plaster region. Original dark pavement is retained; narrowed pale kerb gives a thin warm dusk highlight rather than the rejected broad nearly flat gold apron. Native direct reception does not itself prove a new eligible reflector hit.
appearance.transmitter: Coated mast/cabinet rough PBR retains the photograph and uses reflector-only response. Full accepted front probes identify637/638/639. The close base view remains visually coherent but records no new concrete reception on either route. Surrounding rock, timber and stone counters are not attributed to this model.
appearance.hangar: Near native and CPU controls retain the original panels, dark authored interior and floor. No new near receiver or eligible623 reflector hit is demonstrated. Factory625/626 hits observed from the hangar-yard camera are not hangar adoption. Original eight land-hint vertices block both nearest LODs; only79 farther-LOD prerequisites are accepted, not a visible coverage claim.
appearance.rejected: Built asphalt618 and broad mixed-apron616 lose dark paving detail into gold areas at dusk even with GI off; restored asphalt and narrowed616. Built630/631/632 give conspicuous CPU PBR-on/GI-off window-strip blocks; removed, since disabling GI alone cannot repair the raster boundary. Built hangar beam622 remains blocked by original shape-land gate. Tighter door/kerb boxes that split original fans were expanded only to valid intact single-material faces or left unused.
appearance.motionAndDistance: Original native controls exercise small camera translations/turns at daylight/dusk for all four front views; final factory front/roof repeated after strip removal. No new gross phase-dependent material boundary failure was observed. Retreat views are representative original gameplay scenes, not isolated LOD transition proofs; distant factory-yard cameras can frame neighboring hangars.
appearance.scopeAndProvenance: Full baseline and pre-final runs cover22 native exterior/detail views. Final binary differs only by deleting630/631/632, verified as exact header subtraction. Final factory seven-view matrices, seven factory/close CPU controls, three other-model native guards, bounded probes and factory/yard GPU costs complete the scoped revalidation. The focus-lost absent controls from the earlier run are excluded and rerun, not assumed passed.
appearance.limits: Family counters are half-resolution scene samples, not pixel masks, visible percentages or triangle coverage. Source-qualified floor, roof, supports and intermediate blank-wall faces can remain unavailable to receiver capture. Roughness.90/F0.04/metallic0 are conservative unmeasured approximations; no recovered albedo, new map, transparency, lighting, geometry or gate change. Native CPU-command timing is not CPU-lit-route performance; CPU-lit route was visually tested, not separately timed.
